body.x: Extreme Fliers(www.extremefliers.com), the leading brand in R/C Helicopters, unveiled "Micro Drone 2.0" at CES 2015, which runed Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The Extreme Fliers Micro Drone 2.0 is a tiny quadcopter remote controlled drone that has been created for amature users. In terms of design and abilities, tt has certain aspects of professional drones, but it is easy enough to use and made primarily for beginners.It comes with a kit that includes an HD camera, sensors and a remote control. There are four extensions, or arms, in an X-shape which defines its design. It has a rotor on each arm that makes it fly. The drone is 10.24 x 5.12 x 10.63 inches around and is very lightweight at only 0.01 pounds. The camera is an HD accessory, located on the bottom of the drone, capable of 720p resolution with a slot to place an SD card to store pictures and recorded video footage. The camera has a wide angle lens, so the pictures look more panoramic and scenic, which is very fitting for a device that can take pictures from hundreds of feet in the air.
